summary: Independent G5 Urdu review of EFMP-406 Unit 6 (Issues, Challenges, and Future Directions) Urdu mirror authored by opencode against English baseline accepted at the CMY G3 sign-off desk. Content is substantively faithful and complete across curriculum outcomes, pedagogical sequences, and assessment design: both sub-topics (6.1, 6.2) are fully taught; all 8 declared terminology bank terms are conformed to; all ten MCQs were solved independently blind and match the English and Urdu keys 100% with identical cognitive demands and mark schemes. Disposition is escalate because (1) topic-02.mdx:46 contains a sentence truncation omission dropping the clause translation for supported word reading, and topic-01.mdx:76 drops a clause in the question list (Finding F1), (2) real browser visual rendering (1280px desktop, 360px mobile viewport, A4 print layout) could not be executed under crew brief restrictions forbidding build, servers, and Playwright, leaving accessibility and rtl unverified (Finding F2), (3) the authoritative G3 dependency is an unsigned human desk review (CMY) while the automated G3 report has a stale input manifest following post-review commits (Finding F3), and (4) candidate course terminology awaits owner review for inclusion in terminology.csv (Finding F4). Report is unsigned and advisory; G5 remains open.

findings.message: In i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-3/efmp-406/unit-06/topic-02.mdx:46, sentence truncation drops the translation of 'the next move may be supported word reading', producing broken punctuation and an incomplete thought: 'اگر بچہ اس جملے کو پڑھ نہیں سکتا، ۔ اگر بچہ اسے پڑھ سکتا ہے مگر دعویٰ سے جوڑ نہیں سکتا، تو اگلا قدم استدلال سے متعلق ہے۔'. Action required for author: restore the missing clause (e.g. 'اگر بچہ اس جملے کو پڑھ نہیں سکتا، تو اگلا قدم الفاظ خوانی کی معاونت ہو سکتا ہے۔'). In addition, in topic-01.mdx:76, the second question in the three-question list was translated as a bare 'کردار ہے؟' instead of 'کیا متعلم کا کام میں فعال کردار ہے؟' for 'Does the learner have an active role in the work?'.

No rendered Urdu page or figure inspection in a real browser (1280px desktop, 360px mobile viewport, A4 print layout) was possible in this crew job. The task brief strictly forbids npm run build, dev/preview servers, and Playwright/Chromium. Neither chromium, google-chrome, nor rsvg-convert is installed on the host, and ImageMagick MSVG cannot resolve CSS variables or perform HarfBuzz Nastaliq shaping. Visual verification of Nastaliq shaping, bidi layout, punctuation rendering, and print wrapping remains unverified and requires browser access before final certification.

The G3 English dependency is recorded in specs/content/efmp-406/tasks.md row 67 pointing to specs/content/efmp-406/reviews/unit-06/G3/20261102T210705Z-g3-desk-d3bd5a8a.json from the owner sign-off desk (CMY). All bound English inputs match the current manifest. However, this is a human desk report without an Ed25519 detached signature (.sig). Meanwhile, the automated G3 report at specs/content/efmp-406/reviews/unit-06/G3/f39ce2ec-8915-4b91-be9c-d3b7ce713df8.json has a stale input manifest following post-review commits to topic-01.mdx, topic-02.mdx, and gates.mjs. Automatic G5 verification requires an accepted, qualified G3 report.

Core course terms introduced in EFMP-406 Unit 6 (Literacy / خواندگی, Literacy rate / شرح خواندگی, Access / رسائی, Inclusion / شمولیت, Out-of-school children / اسکول سے باہر بچے, Multimodal text / کثیر نمطی متن, Trend / رجحان, Prediction / پیش گوئی) are applied consistently across prose, figures, and assessment, but have no entries in specs/content/terminology.csv. The curriculum owner should review and bank these terms in a future governance update.
